input.brief: Red Sea Horizons: four destinations, reef trips, agency-managed stays and personal staff approval; ocean navy turquoise sand brand

direction.name: Photographs at uneven sizes
direction.idea: A calm page where the pictures are placed like prints on a gallery wall: each at its own size and position, with text set small and light between them. Nothing lines up in the obvious way, yet everything sits on a grid you can feel. The unevenness is what makes it read as art-directed by a person: a small portrait far left, a wide landscape running off the right edge, a square that overlaps the next section. It lets photographs lead without ever becoming a slideshow.
direction.composition: A 12-column grid with wide margins (5–7vw). The hero is a single line of large light type (6–9vw) across the top third, and below it one photograph placed off-centre (columns 6–12, 16:10), its top edge overlapping the baseline zone of the headline by a few pixels of deliberate tension. Each following section places two or three photographs with different spans and vertical offsets: for example a 3:4 portrait in columns 2–5 starting 120px lower than a 16:10 landscape in columns 7–12; then a single small 1:1 in columns 9–11 beside a paragraph in columns 2–6. Paragraphs are short (max 40ch) and sit in the gaps. No two consecutive sections use the same arrangement. Vertical spacing is large and irregular on purpose (120–260px).
direction.typography: A light or regular weight at large size for the few headings; small, quiet text. Serif or a slender sans. Everything left-aligned to grid lines.
direction.colour: A pale neutral ground with one deep ink taken from the photographs. No accent beyond a quiet link colour.
direction.imagery: Six to nine photographs from one set, in a deliberate mix of ratios (3:4, 4:5, 1:1, 16:10, 21:9). Square corners. Captions, if any, are one short line under an image in the soft ink.
direction.richness: Placement. The differing sizes and offsets create movement on a still page.
direction.pitfalls: Uneven is not random: every image edge lands on a column line, and offsets come from a small set of values. On a phone, keep the unevenness with alternating widths (100%, 72% left, 60% right) rather than stacking everything full width.

hero.name: Three prints, one line
hero.blueprint: Photographs lead and the type stays small. A pale ground, a 12-column grid, 5vw side margins. The top row at 15px holds the wordmark left, three text links centred and the single action right. Three photographs with square corners hang from one shared top line at 18% of the viewport height, like prints pinned along a rail, each a different size so their bottom edges fall at three heights. A small 1:1 in columns 1-2 (about 190px). A tall 3:4 in columns 4-7, about 440px wide and 590px tall, the largest thing on screen. A 16:10 landscape in columns 9-12 that continues past the right margin and is cropped by the viewport edge. Columns 3 and 8 are left empty as breathing space. The headline sits under the small photograph, left-aligned to its left edge across columns 1-3: a light serif or slender sans at clamp(30px, 2.8vw, 44px) on two lines, followed by one sentence at 16px in the soft ink, max 30ch. One line of caption at 14px sits under the left corner of each of the other two photographs.
hero.mobile: The rail turns vertical, so left edges vary instead of bottoms. The tall photograph comes first at 72% of the width on the left margin; the small square follows at 38% of the width, pushed to the right margin and overlapping the first by 40px; the landscape runs full bleed below. The headline at 8vw sits beside the square on the left, with the sentence at 16px under it.
hero.headline: A quiet 3-6 word line at about 40px, at most 36 characters across two lines.

motion.name: Shutter image
motion.description: The one hero or showcase image opens from an edge with a clip-path over about 1.1 seconds while the picture inside settles from 1.12 scale to rest. Use it once, on the image that matters most; later images simply are there. Recipe: 'Image shutter' in references/motion.md.

sections.name: Pinned sentence, photographs pass
sections.blueprint: A wrapper 300svh tall. Inside it a `position: sticky; top: 0` layer of 100svh holds one sentence of 8–14 words, centred, three lines at clamp(36px, 4.6vw, 68px), leading 1.1, in a block 62% of the viewport wide. The sentence is a paragraph, not a heading; it is white with `mix-blend-mode: difference` (or a solid ink that reads over every photograph) and has a higher `z-index` than the images. Behind it, three photographs sit in normal flow at different sizes and sides and scroll past the fixed sentence: a 4:5 portrait 24vw wide with its left edge at 6vw; 70svh lower a 16:10 landscape 38vw wide touching the right margin; 70svh lower a 1:1 frame 18vw wide starting at 30vw. Each crosses the sentence once. When the wrapper ends, the sentence releases and scrolls away with the last photograph. No scroll hijacking.
sections.mobile: Wrapper 260svh. The sentence pins at 40% of the screen height at 8.4vw, four or five lines, with 20px margins. Photographs alternate: 64% wide on the left margin, 78% wide on the right margin, then 52% on the left, with 50svh between them.

sections.name: Band of unequal panels
sections.blueprint: A modest heading, then one wide band of pictures. The heading, two to four words at 36–44px, starts at column 3, left of centre, with 64px beneath it. The band spans the full viewport width edge to edge and is 68svh tall: four photographs standing side by side with no gaps and deliberately unequal widths, a flex row with flex-grow values of 5, 2, 3 and 2. Each panel is cropped with object-fit: cover to a tall slice, so the band reads as one folded view. The first panel carries a two-line title at 28px in paper colour at its top-left, 24px in, over a neutral scrim that covers only that corner. Hovering a panel raises its flex-grow to 6 over 500ms while the others give way; without hover the widths simply stay. One caption line at 16px sits under the band at the left margin.
sections.mobile: The heading sits on the margin at 28px. The band becomes a two-by-two block with no gaps, 84svh tall in total: the first row split 64/36 and the second 36/64, so the slices stay unequal. The title stays on the first panel. No hover behaviour.

sections.name: Rising triptych
sections.blueprint: A wrapper about 200svh tall holds a sticky stage of 100svh on the plain page ground. The heading, two lines at clamp(32px, 2.8vw, 44px), is centred in the top fifth of the stage with one sentence at 17px under it. From the bottom edge three photographs rise as the page scrolls, each at its own speed. The centre one, a 4:5 portrait, starts 620px wide with only its top quarter showing and grows (scale and travel on a scroll-linked timeline) until it is about 760px wide with its top 40px below the sentence, cropped by the bottom edge, so it never reaches the heading. In the study it slides over the heading; here nothing lies on top of a heading. The two outer ones, each 360×530px, stand beside it with 10px gaps, their tops always 55px lower than the centre's, and by the end they are cut by the left and right viewport edges. Square corners, no captions, one consistent light across all three (warm interiors with warm, cold coast with cold). Under reduced motion show the end state with the heading above the three photographs.
sections.mobile: The centre portrait starts at 60% of the width and grows to nearly the full height; the outer two show as 40px slivers at the screen edges. The heading and sentence sit in the top third above it.

sections.name: Wide photo, colour tile, facts
sections.blueprint: Top: a heading of two to four words at clamp(40px, 4vw, 60px) on the left margin, then 24px below it a three-line lead paragraph at 21–22px across columns 1–6. 72px lower, two tiles sit side by side with a 16px gap. The left tile spans columns 1–8: a landscape photograph at 16:10 with one radius (0 or 10px). A short paragraph of up to 35 words at 16px is set in a solid paper-colour block 320px wide with 20px padding, placed over the photograph's top-right corner and flush with both edges. The right tile spans columns 9–12 and is a flat palette colour, 60% of the photograph's height: it holds a simple inline SVG outline of the region or the floor plan as one filled shape, with one solid dot marking the location. Under the colour tile, four label and value pairs at 14px in a two-by-two grid: altitude, distance, season, local time.
sections.mobile: Heading at 9vw, lead at 18px. The photograph goes full width at 4:3 and its overlaid paragraph moves beneath it as ordinary text. The colour tile follows at full width and 3:2, and the four label and value pairs sit under it in two columns.

sections.name: Three photographs, then a field
sections.blueprint: Two parts with no gap between them. First, a strip of three photographs butted edge to edge across the full viewport, each one third wide and 40svh tall, `object-fit: cover`, no gutters and no captions; give all three the same treatment. Directly beneath, a band in one flat palette colour, about 44svh tall. In the band, columns 1–7: the closing statement at 26–30px over three lines in the band's assigned ink, with exactly one phrase underlined by a 4px bar (`text-decoration-thickness: 4px; text-underline-offset: 6px`), and that phrase is the link; two lines at 16px follow 32px lower. In the lower-right corner, columns 11–12, a small portrait photograph (4:5, about 150px wide) sits 40px from the band's edges: the person who will answer. There is no button; the underlined phrase is the action.
sections.mobile: The strip becomes one full-width photograph at 4:3 with the other two side by side beneath it at half width each, still gutterless. The band follows: statement at 22px, the two small lines, and the portrait at 96px wide in the bottom-right corner.

sections.name: Columns above, wordmark below
sections.blueprint: The footer inverts ground and ink and fills a whole viewport (min-height 100svh), arranged as three rows in a grid (auto 1fr auto). Top row, 40px from the edge: four small columns on the 12-column grid (address, navigation, social, hours or contact), each a plain list at 15–16px with its first line in the full ink and the rest in the softer ink. Middle row: empty. Bottom row: the wordmark alone, sized to run from the left margin to the right margin on one line. Set it as inline SVG text with a `viewBox` fitted to the word and `width: 100%`, or tune `font-size` in `vw` to the letter count, so it never wraps; its baseline sits 20px above a single line of legal text at 13px. With `position: sticky; bottom: 0` and a lower `z-index` than the page, the last section slides away to uncover it.
sections.mobile: Columns become two by two at 15px with 32px between rows, at the top. A gap of about 20svh follows. The wordmark spans the full width at the bottom; a name longer than ten letters stacks on two lines, each fitted to the width. Legal line beneath at 12px.

references.name: Sobha Privy Collection
references.idea: Luxury homes sold by restraint: a black sculptural render and a script-over-capitals title, then white pages where interior images grow and overlap huge serif capitals as you scroll.
references.hero: Full-bleed near-black video of a glossy black sculptural form, wide curved bands catching thin highlights, filling the frame at very low contrast. A centred two-line title about 46% of the width: a formal script phrase at about 6.9vw, then a line of light roman serif capitals at about 6vw directly beneath, wider than the script. Nothing else in the middle. Corners only: a two-line hamburger with a menu label top-left, a small serif wordmark with a micro subtitle top-centre, a text link top-right, a circled down-arrow bottom-left, and bottom-right a greyscale 3D-map thumbnail about 17% wide with a numeral and a two-line label.
references.type: TT Ramillas in light uppercase for display (up to 7.9vw) paired with the formal script Altesse for two- or three-word accent phrases that overlap the capitals; TT Commons Pro at 13px for nav, eyebrows and body. A very large jump from 100px display to 13px text.
references.colour: #010101 #ffffff #d8cdbd #8a7862 #1a1919 — Black hero, then pure white pages with near-black type. Warmth comes only from the beige, cream and bronze interiors in the renders. No accent colour anywhere.
references.imagery: Architectural interior renders in cream and bronze (double-height dining halls, lounges, marble pool rooms) in tall portrait and near-square crops, square corners, arranged in groups of different sizes that scale with scroll. The hero is an abstract black sculptural render.
references.layout: Centred, symmetrical compositions (heading over a three-image group) alternate with asymmetric ones (large left-aligned capitals with images offset right and lower-left). A very long scroll-driven page of about 48 screens, with pinned image scaling between text moments.

sections.description: White section, centred. A two-line micro eyebrow in tracked capitals, then a two-line heading in light serif capitals at about 2.6vw. Below it a triptych: a tall centre image about 23vw wide at 3:4, flanked by two shorter images set lower, their tops about 30% down the centre image and their outer edges touching the viewport sides. On scroll the centre image scales up and the side images rise toward its top.

Pinned scaling group: the same three renders rearranged so the centre image is about 26vw wide and roughly 30% taller than its neighbours, which hang from a common line a little below its top and are cropped by the left and right viewport edges. Gaps are under 1vw. The fixed header stays above, its logo sitting on top of the image.

Statement with overlap: five lines of light serif capitals at about 5.5vw, flush left on a 1% margin, filling the left 55%. A grey script phrase overlaps the end of the last line and runs into a tall image occupying the right 25% from mid-height to the bottom. A second, small image about 12vw wide sits lower left under the text. Mid-transition frames show the capitals rising letter by letter from behind a baseline mask.

steal: Pair one short phrase in formal script with a line of light serif capitals beneath it, letting the script overlap the capitals or run into an adjacent image.
Arrange three images as a tall centre flanked by two lower ones cropped by the viewport edges, then scale the centre up on scroll.
Keep the hero to a near-black, low-contrast render with all controls pushed to the four corners so the centred title is the only bright thing.
references.media: A WebGL black ribbon covers the whole first screen behind the centred slogan, with a 240x140 map clip docked bottom-right (about 2.6%). Later: a centre portrait that grows from about 620 to 760px wide as it rises, a triptych with the flanking pictures cropped by the viewport edges, a picture sliding under the last lines of a statement, full-bleed night-skyline video interludes, a curved WebGL carousel pinned under a title and long pinned horizontal galleries; 28 images and 9 muted loops, square corners.
references.motion: After a preloader of about 1s the title drifts up a few pixels and settles by 2.5s, and Locomotive smooth scroll then scrubs nearly everything by transform as a continuous lerp: pictures move faster than text, each section slides over the previous one, and the three-worlds chapter pins a curved carousel and horizontal tracks for about 23,000px. 187 spans rise over 1.4s cubic-bezier(0.29,0.52,0.5,1) and 114 fade over 1s cubic-bezier(0.7,0,0.3,1), the stylesheet's main curve (32 uses).

references.name: Tengile Malamala Collection
references.idea: Let the land and animals carry everything: one staggered hairline-serif headline over aerial footage, then cream pages of olive-green serif text with photographs placed at uneven sizes.
references.hero: Aerial river footage fills the viewport, slightly darkened. Three small white caps items sit on the top edge: an enquiry link hard left, a stacked three-line wordmark centred, 'menu' hard right. The headline is two words on two lines in thin serif capitals about 8.3vw tall: the first line starts 10% from the left, the second is indented to 40% and ends near 90%, so the pair steps diagonally across the middle third. Below, starting at the 50% line, a three-line serif sentence at about 20px and a small white square-cornered button with a separate arrow square beside it. The lower third is left to the water.
references.type: PP Fragment at hairline weight (220): capitals for the 120px headline, sentence case for 28-36px olive statements. Inter at 11-16px for labels, nav and small paragraphs. Three serif sizes, two sans sizes; the serif never goes bold.
references.colour: #f5eee9 #5c6e21 #181608 #e3e1d4 #ffffff — Warm cream page with every word, large or small, in one olive green; the footer inverts to a solid olive field with cream text. Photography supplies all other colour.
references.imagery: Wildlife and lodge photography, natural and saturated, square corners, no overlays. Mixed aspect ratios placed at different widths and vertical offsets; lodge listings use equal landscape triplets; hero and closing band are full-bleed aerials.
references.layout: Narrow 16px outer margins and a twelve-column grid used asymmetrically: label and small paragraph in the left columns, the large statement starting at the midpoint. Sections alternate between loosely scattered image pairs and tidy three-up rows.

sections.description: Cream field. A tiny sans caps label top-left. A 28px olive serif paragraph of eight lines occupies only the right half, starting at the midpoint. Far below on the left, a five-line 12px sans paragraph about 180px wide. Images are placed loose: a landscape elephant photo under the right text, a tall leopard portrait lower at the left margin, a wide crop of elephant legs upper right of the next screen. No two share a top edge or width.

A tiny caps label, then an olive serif statement at about 36px running the full width for four lines. Beneath: a sub-label, a 12px paragraph held to a third of the width, then three equal landscape photos with 8px gutters spanning margin to margin, each captioned below in small serif. The same block repeats for a second category; one tile is dimmed with a short caps line laid over it to mark it as not yet open.

A full-bleed aerial of an elephant crossing a sandbank with a short serif statement, a small sans paragraph and the white button-plus-arrow pair set in the right half only. It butts directly against a solid olive footer: five columns of small cream links under tiny caps headings in the top third, a large empty green area beneath, and a legal line along the bottom edge.

steal: Stagger a two-line headline: first line from the left margin, second indented by 30% so the pair steps diagonally across the image.
Set every piece of text in a single brand colour on cream and make the footer that same colour as a solid field.
Split the button into two adjacent squares, label and arrow, with a 4px gap, small and square-cornered, instead of one pill.
references.media: A 10s muted aerial montage covers the whole first screen with type set on it and no visible scrim. Below: a split with an image and paragraph in the right half from the centre line, staggered image pairs with uneven heights and offsets, a three-up card row with captions, an inset full-width slider, a constellation of thumbnails round a centred heading, a slow portrait marquee, and a sticky full-bleed landscape with the closing call scrolling over it; 33 images, pictures oversized about 110% in their masks for drift.
references.motion: There is no preloader and only the montage cuts after 400ms, but under Lenis content stays hidden until each reveal fires: blocks rise and sharpen from a blur over 1.6s cubic-bezier(0.19,1,0.22,1), others fade with a filter over 1s cubic-bezier(0.165,0.84,0.44,1), pictures drift inside their masks, and the closing landscape holds on a sticky root. The ground steps from cream to sage-beige to olive, and the marquee loops on 120s.

references.name: White Desert
references.idea: One word, the destination, set a third of the screen tall over footage like a film title card; sheer scale stands in for remoteness.
references.hero: Full-bleed video (the view from an aircraft window over an ice shelf, darkly vignetted by the window frame) fills the viewport. Faint vertical hairlines divide it into six columns. Top-left, three outlined rectangular nav buttons about 120 by 40px with 6px gaps; top-right, two more; between them a small white mountain logo over a condensed caps name. One condensed uppercase word spans almost the full width at 17.8vw, white, centred, anchored so its baseline sits about 35px above the bottom edge. At mid-height a two-line italic serif tagline at about 16px hangs on the first column line at left, and a film-play label sits between two hairlines at right.
references.type: Three voices: Oswald 400 uppercase for the giant word and footer wordmark (up to 22vw); Cardinal Classic Long, a light high-contrast serif, for caps statements near 32px and italic taglines; Inter Tight 14px for nav and body. Body to display is roughly an 18x jump.
references.colour: #040608 #ffffff #e9e7e1 #1f2b4d #f5821f #95979a — Footage and near-black open the page; content sections flip to pure white with navy serif type and end on a warm grey footer. One small orange tab is the only accent. Cool overall.
references.imagery: Aerial and wildlife footage and stills of ice, penguins and rust-coloured rock peaks, natural cool grade, always full-bleed with square corners; trips appear as tall vertical image slices set side by side with no gaps.
references.layout: A six-column grid made visible by faint full-height hairlines runs through every section. Text blocks are small and hung off column lines, often starting at column two or three, with large voids around them. Full-bleed image screens alternate with nearly empty white text screens.

sections.description: A white screen with the six vertical hairlines still showing. A serif caps paragraph at about 32px, navy, light weight and tight leading, occupies only columns two to four, left-aligned with its first line indented by half the measure. Above its top-left sits a small italic label ringed by a loose hand-drawn pen scribble. An orange vertical tab with rotated text is fixed to the right edge.

Leaving the hero, the giant word blurs and dissolves into white mist that becomes the next section's background. Later a full-viewport photograph of jagged rock peaks in snow bleeds to all four edges, with a narrow 13px paragraph from the white section above overlapping its top edge at a column line, so text and image interlock rather than stack.

A serif caps heading at about 40px sits left of centre with a long pencil-like scribble underline that extends well past the words on both sides. Below, a full-width band of four vertical image panels with no gaps and unequal widths, like an accordion; the first panel carries a two-line italic serif title in white at its top-left.

Warm grey field. The top row holds a small logo, three columns of grey link lists with italic serif group headings and, at right, a stack of square-cornered off-white tiles (a video thumbnail, two half-width buttons, one full-width). Beneath, the brand name in navy condensed caps runs edge to edge at about 22vw. A final strip has award badges left, a centred italic quotation and legal links right.

steal: Set a single place name in condensed caps at about 18vw, centred and anchored to the bottom edge of full-bleed footage, with everything else on screen at 14-16px.
Leave the column grid visible as faint full-height hairlines across video, white and footer sections, and hang small text blocks off those lines.
Ring or underline small serif labels with a loose hand-drawn pen scribble to put one human mark into an otherwise strict layout.
references.media: An 18s muted aerial and ice-cave clip covers the whole first screen under a scrim, with the title docked along the bottom edge. Later pictures dissolve into the white page through fog-like fades, a horizontal accordion opens one trip panel at half width beside blurred slivers, vertical ice strips wipe across the previous photograph, and a long pinned track of inset cards floats on a full-bleed texture ground before a closing photo panel carrying a quotation; 20 images, one video, square corners and a high-key cold grade.
references.motion: There is no entrance choreography and footage plays from the first frame; under Lenis the hero title blurs and is swallowed by a sticky fog layer growing from 390 to 900px tall, statement lines fill from grey to navy, the camps heading scrubs from 140px down to 60px, and a pinned horizontal track moves the cards at about 0.56px per scrolled pixel over an 8,328px runway. Blocks rise 20rem with opacity over 1.4s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1), and hovers run .3s cubic-bezier(.5,1,.89,1).
